name: Al Majidi

queries.query: Al Majidi Yemen official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry public viewer API
queries.result: First-party Yemen sources found the national cadastral law, Ministry of Justice land-registry/materials pages, the Central Statistical Organization GIS Center, and Geological Survey map information. No official public parcel viewer, parcel API, schema, CRS, or Al Majidi-specific cadastral geometry was found.

queries.query: اليمن المجيدي خريطة عقارية مساحية سجل عقاري رسمي
queries.result: First-party Arabic search found Yemen cadastral-registration law and Ministry of Justice material describing cadastral maps and registry administration, plus a GIS Center page describing statistical/administrative mapping. These are institutional/legal references, not a public parcel layer or Al Majidi service. Commercial property map results were excluded as non-cadastral and non-first-party.

registryEvidence.custodian: Yemen Ministry of Justice / real-estate registry and documentation administration is referenced by official law and Ministry pages; the Central Statistical Organization GIS Center and Geological Survey are general mapping institutions.
registryEvidence.basis: Official pages evidence national legal/administrative responsibility and mapping capability only. No city/local registry office or public parcel service for Al Majidi was evidenced, so registryFound remains null.

officialSources.observation: Official Ministry of Justice-hosted regulatory document for the Surveying Authority describes land-registry and surveying organizational functions; it does not expose a parcel API or viewer.

Official Ministry of Justice service page includes a public-facing map-related service description, but no anonymous parcel data endpoint, schema, or downloadable Al Majidi geometry was exposed in the fetched page.
officialSources.scope: Ministry service catalogue; not verified parcel coverage.

officialSources.observation: Central Statistical Organization GIS Center describes statistical, administrative, and interactive mapping responsibilities; page says interactive maps are forthcoming and is not a cadastral parcel service.
Geological Survey information page was discovered as a map catalogue; direct request timed out during this attempt and no parcel service was verified.
Government-hosted legal text states that registration relies on general and special cadastral maps and unit records; it is legal evidence, not an open data endpoint.
